rows.label: Faint enchantment; CL 3rd; Forge Ring, charm animal; Price 10,800 gp.
rows.price: Blinking: On command, this ring makes the wearer blink, as with the blink spell.

rows.label: Climbing: This ring is actually a magic leather cord that ties around a finger. It continually grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Climb checks.
rows.price: Faint transmutatation; CL 5th; Forge Ring, creator must have 5 ranks in the Climb skill; Price 2,500 gp.

rows.label: Moderate evocation; CL 11th; Forge Ring, imbue with spell ability; Price 4,000 gp.
rows.price: Djinni Calling: One of the many rings of fable, this “genie” ring is most useful indeed. It serves as a special gate by means of which a specific djinni can be called from the Elemental Plane of Air. When the ring is rubbed (a standard action), the call goes out, and the djinni appears on the next round. The djinni faithfully obeys and serves the wearer of the ring, but never for more than 1 hour per day. If the djinni of the ring is ever killed, the ring becomes nonmagical and worthless.

rows.label: Creatures from the plane to which the ring is attuned who attack the wearer take a –1 penalty on their attack rolls. The ring wearer makes applicable saving throws from the extraplanar creature’s attacks with a +2 resistance bonus. He gains a +4 morale bonus on all attack rolls against such creatures. Any weapon he uses bypasses the damage reduction of such creatures, regardless of any qualities the weapon may or may not have.
rows.price: The wearer of the ring is able to converse with creatures from the plane to which his ring is attuned. These creatures recognize that he wears the ring. They show a healthy respect for the wearer if alignments are similar. If alignments are opposed, creatures fear the wearer if he is strong. If he is weak, they hate and desire to slay him.

rows.label: The ring appears to be a ring of water walking until the established condition is met.
rows.price: Strong conjuration; CL 15th; Forge Ring, summon monster VI, all appropriate spells; Price 200,000 gp.

rows.label: Evasion: This ring continually grants the wearer the ability to avoid damage as if she had evasion. Whenever she makes a Reflex saving throw to determine whether she takes half damage, a successful save results in no damage.
rows.price: Moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Forge Ring, jump; Price 25,000 gp.

rows.label: Moderate evocation; CL 9th; Forge Ring, wall of force; Price 8,500 gp.
rows.price: Freedom of Movement: This gold ring allows the wearer to act as if continually under the effect of a freedom of movement spell.

rows.label: Invisibility: By activating this simple silver ring, the wearer can benefit from invisibility, as the spell.
rows.price: Faint illusion; CL 3rd; Forge Ring, invisibility; Price 20,000 gp.

rows.label: Moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Forge Ring, creator must have 10 ranks in the Jump skill; Price 10,000 gp.
rows.price: Mind Shielding: This ring is usually of fine workmanship and wrought from heavy gold. The wearer is continually immune to detect thoughts, discern lies, and any attempt to magically discern her alignment.

rows.label: Ram: The ring of the ram is an ornate ring forged of hard metal, usually iron or an iron alloy. It has the head of a ram as its device.
rows.price: The wearer can command the ring to give forth a ramlike force, manifested by a vaguely discernible shape that resembles the head of a ram or a goat. This force strikes a single target, dealing 1d6 points of damage if 1 charge is expended, 2d6 points if 2 charges are used, or 3d6 points if 3 charges (the maximum) are used. Treat this as a ranged attack with a 50-foot maximum range and no penalties for distance.

rows.label: Moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Forge Ring, bull’s strength, telekinesis; Price 8,600 gp.
rows.price: Regeneration: This white gold ring continually allows a living wearer to heal 1 point of damage per level every hour rather than every day. (This ability cannot be aided by the Heal skill.) Nonlethal damage heals at a rate of 1 point of damage per level every 5 minutes. If the wearer loses a limb, an organ, or any other body part while wearing this ring, the ring regenerates it as the spell. In either case, only damage taken while wearing the ring is regenerated.

rows.label: Once the ball lightning function is activated, the balls can be released at any time before the sun rises. (Multiple balls can be released in the same round.)
rows.price: The second special function produces three shooting stars that can be released from the ring each week, simultaneously or one at a time. They impact for 12 points of damage and spread (as a fireball) in a 5-foot-radius sphere for 24 points of fire damage.

rows.label: • Spark shower (special, once per day)
rows.price: The spark shower is a flying cloud of sizzling purple sparks that fan out from the ring for a distance of 20 feet in an arc 10 feet wide. Creatures within this area take 2d8 points of damage each if not wearing metal armor or carrying a metal weapon. Those wearing metal armor and/or carrying a metal weapon take 4d8 points of damage.

rows.label: A spellcaster can cast any spells into the ring, so long as the total spell levels do not add up to more than three. Metamagic versions of spells take up storage space equal to their spell level modified by the metamagic feat. A spellcaster can use a scroll to put a spell into the minor ring of spell storing.
rows.price: The ring magically imparts to the wearer the names of all spells currently stored within it.

rows.label: Spell Storing, Major: As the minor ring of spell storing, except it holds up to ten levels of spells.
rows.price: Strong evocation; CL 17th; Forge Ring, imbue with spell ability; Price 200,000 gp.

rows.label: Faint conjuration; CL 5th; Forge Ring, create food and water; Price 2,500 gp.
rows.price: Swimming: This silver ring has a wave pattern etched into the band. It continually grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Swim checks.

rows.label: Telekinesis: This ring allows the caster to use the spell telekinesis on command.
rows.price: Moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Forge Ring, telekinesis; Price 75,000 gp.

rows.label: Moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Forge Ring, water walk; Price 15,000 gp.
rows.price: Wizardry: This special ring comes in four kinds (ring of wizardry I, ring of wizardry II, ring of wizardry III, and ring of wizardry IV), all of them useful only to arcane spellcasters. The wearer’s arcane spells per day are doubled for one specific spell level. A ring of wizardry I doubles 1st-level spells, a ring of wizardry II doubles 2nd-level spells, a ring of wizardry III doubles 3rd-level spells, and a ring of wizardry IV doubles 4th-level spells. Bonus spells from high ability scores or school specialization are not doubled.

rows.label: Moderate divination; CL 6th; Forge Ring, true seeing; Price 25,000 gp.
These sturdy items have AC 9, 10 hit points, hardness 10, and a break DC of 27.
rows.price: Activation: Details relating to rod use vary from item to item. See the individual descriptions for specifics.
